originalProposals.reason: Identifies water waves as transverse because the surface oscillates up-down while the wave travels across, a current G6-F-7 transverse and G6-F-9 transverse-example facet. G6-F-8 model unit not credited (no rope/string model). G9-F-10 transverse is EMR, not water waves. Full EN/TL/BIS and both pools inspected; single card ID.

evidence.quote: Water waves are transverse waves, because the water surface moves up and down while the wave travels across the water.
